title: Paraguay Stuns Germany, Morocco Downs Netherlands on Penalties in World Cup Round of 32
detail: The Round of 32 delivered two of the tournament's biggest shocks: Paraguay eliminated Germany 4-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw (Havertz 54', Enciso 42'), with Germany coach Julian Nagelsmann calling a disallowed extra-time goal for Jonathan Tah "a joke" after VAR review. Morocco eliminated the Netherlands 3-2 on penalties after a 1-1 draw (Gakpo 72', Diop 90+1'). Brazil beat Japan 2-1 (Casemiro 56', Martinelli 90+5') at NRG Stadium, Houston, while Canada edged South Africa 1-0 on an Eustaquio stoppage-time winner at SoFi Stadium to reach the Round of 16 in Canada's first-ever men's World Cup knockout match.
